candidates.evidence_text: GATE OPENING SIZES ARE NOT SHOWN ON THIS SHEET. REFER TO THE GATE DETAILS, SECTION 32 31 13 AND ANY ADDENDA FOR GATE REQUIREMENTS.
candidates.value: Gate opening sizes are not shown on this sheet. Refer to the gate details, section 32 31 13 and any addenda for gate requirements.

candidates.evidence_text: SPACE LINE POSTS EQUALLY BETWEEN CORNER, TERMINAL AND GATE POSTS AT 10'-0" O.C. MAXIMUM.
candidates.value: Space line posts equally between corner, terminal and gate posts at 10'-0" o.c. maximum.

candidates.evidence_text: FABRIC, FRAMEWORK, FITTINGS, FOOTINGS AND INSTALLATION SHALL CONFORM TO SECTION 32 31 13 - CHAIN LINK FENCES AND GATES, AND TO SHEETS F501 AND F502.
candidates.value: Fabric, framework, fittings, footings and installation shall conform to section 32 31 13 - chain link fences and gates, and to sheets F501 and F502.

candidates.evidence_text: COURT PAVEMENT, SURFACING, PLAYING LINES, NETS AND NET POSTS ARE BY OTHERS AND ARE SHOWN FOR REFERENCE ONLY. COORDINATE POST LOCATIONS WITH PAVEMENT CONTRACTOR BEFORE PLACEMENT.
candidates.value: Court pavement, surfacing, playing lines, nets and net posts are by others and are shown for reference only. Coordinate post locations with pavement contractor before placement.

candidates.evidence_text: VERIFY ALL DIMENSIONS AND LAYOUT IN THE FIELD BEFORE SETTING POSTS. REPORT DISCREPANCIES TO THE OWNER'S REPRESENTATIVE IN WRITING AND AWAIT DIRECTION.
candidates.value: Verify all dimensions and layout in the field before setting posts. Report discrepancies to the owner's representative in writing and await direction.

candidates.evidence_text: BID ALTERNATE A-1 (THREE-COURT ENCLOSURE, VIEW 2) IS BID IN LIEU OF THE BASE BID FOUR-COURT ENCLOSURE (VIEW 1). EACH OPTION SHALL BE QUANTIFIED INDEPENDENTLY. SEE C102.
candidates.value: Bid alternate A-1 (three-court enclosure, view 2) is bid in lieu of the base bid four-court enclosure (view 1). Each option shall be quantified independently. See C102.

candidates.evidence_text: LABOR COMPLIANCE: THE CONTRACTOR SHALL VERIFY WHETHER FEDERAL (DAVIS-BACON), STATE OR LOCAL PREVAILING-WAGE REQUIREMENTS, TRADE CLASSIFICATIONS AND CERTIFIED-PAYROLL OBLIGATIONS APPLY, AS STATED IN THE CONTRACT LABOR-COMPLIANCE DOCUMENTS. APPLICABILITY IS NOT ESTABLISHED BY THESE DRAWINGS. SUBMIT A WRITTEN REQUEST FOR CLARIFICATION BEFORE THE QUESTION DEADLINE.
candidates.value: Labor compliance: The contractor shall verify whether federal (Davis-Bacon), state or local prevailing-wage requirements, trade classifications and certified-payroll obligations apply, as stated in the contract labor-compliance documents. Applicability is not established by these drawings. Submit a written request for clarification before the question deadline.

candidates.evidence_text: LOCATE AND PROTECT ALL UNDERGROUND UTILITIES THROUGH THE STATE ONE-CALL SYSTEM BEFORE EXCAVATING FOR POST FOOTINGS.
candidates.value: Locate and protect all underground utilities through the state one-call system before excavating for post footings.

candidates.value: Addenda issued during the bid period supersede conflicting information on this sheet.
